ARTROLLER-LOAD_PERSONAL_EDITS.title: Load Personal Edits
ARTROLLER-LOAD_PERSONAL_EDITS.hover.desc: Shows the art you saved with the Art Roller personal editor.
ARTROLLER-PERSONAL_EDIT_MODE.title: Personal Edit Mode
ARTROLLER-PERSONAL_EDIT_MODE.hover.desc: Adds editing controls beside a card inspected in the Compendium. Edits you save there apply only on this computer and override the card's normal art.
ARTROLLER-DEVELOPER_MODE.title: Developer Mode
ARTROLLER-DEVELOPER_MODE.hover.desc: For mod authors. Everything in Personal Edit Mode, plus additional tools for saving files to your own mod's folder to be packaged later.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_HUE.title: Hue
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_HUE.desc: Rotates every color around the color wheel.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SATURATION.title: Saturation
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_LUMINANCE.title: Luminance
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_RED.title: Red
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_GREEN.title: Green
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_BLUE.title: Blue
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_CONTRAST.title: Contrast
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TINT.title: Tint
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TINT.desc: Multiplies the whole image by a specified color.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_GAMMA.title: Gamma
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_GAMMA.desc: Darkens or lifts the midtones while leaving pure black and white alone.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_RED_OFFSET.title: Red Offset
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_GREEN_OFFSET.title: Green Offset
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_BLUE_OFFSET.title: Blue Offset
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TAB_STANDARD.title: Standard
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TAB_STANDARD.desc:
Adjustments that apply to the whole image.

Order of operations: this tab applies first, as Red, Green and Blue with their offsets, then Hue, Sat and Lum, then Contrast, Gamma and Tint. The Selective Hue sets then work on the result.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TAB_SELECTIVE.title: Selective Hue
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_TAB_SELECTIVE.desc:
Up to three sets that each change only one color in the art, such as turning a blue flame purple while leaving everything else alone.

Order of operations: these apply after everything on the Standard tab, then Set 1, Set 2 and Set 3 in turn. Each set works on the art as the sets above it left it, which is exactly what you see on the card.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_TARGET.title: Selective Hue: Target
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_TARGET.desc:
The color this set changes. Only its hue counts, so darker and paler versions of it are caught too.

To target a color straight from the card, click the swatch, press the eyedropper button in the color picker, then click that pixel in the card's art.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_WIDTH.title: Selective Hue: Width
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_WIDTH.desc: How close to the target a color must be to change. Low catches only that exact hue, high catches all the other hues around it.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_SHIFT.title: Selective Hue: Shift
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_SHIFT.desc: Rotates the targeted colors around the color wheel.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_SATURATION.de: Mutes or intensifies the targeted colors.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_BRIGHTNESS.de: Darkens or lightens the targeted colors.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_SOFTNESS.desc: How gradually the change fades out toward the edge of Width. Raise it if a recolor leaves a visible fringe.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_RESET.title: Reset Set
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SELECTIVE_RESET.desc: Puts this set back to its defaults.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_FLIP_X.title: Flip X
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_FLIP_X.desc: Mirrors the art left to right.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_FLIP_Y.title: Flip Y
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_FLIP_Y.desc: Mirrors the art top to bottom.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_COPY.title: Copy
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_COPY.desc: Remembers this card's current settings so you can paste them onto other cards. Copies the colors and flips, not the portrait.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_PASTE.title: Paste
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_PASTE.desc: Applies the copied settings to this card.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_RESET.title: Reset
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_RESET.desc: Puts every setting back to neutral and shows the card's original art.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_PORTRAIT.title: Portrait
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_PORTRAIT.desc: Replaces this card's art with any other card's. Type part of a name, then pick a result.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SAVE.title: Save
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SAVE.desc:
Saves these settings as your personal roll for this card. 

A personal roll is local to this machine.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_CLEAR.title: Clear
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_CLEAR.desc: Deletes your personal roll for this card, so it goes back to its normal art.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SAVE_DEFAULT.title: Save Default
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_SAVE_DEFAULT.desc: Writes these settings as a roll to ship with your mod, into the output folder below.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_CLEAR_DEFAULT.title: Clear Default
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_CLEAR_DEFAULT.desc: Deletes this card's default roll file from the output folder below.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_OUTPUT_FOLDER.title: Output Folder
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_OUTPUT_FOLDER.desc: Where Save Default writes. Point it at your mod's ArtRoller folder in your repo, then rebuild to pack the rolls.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_BROWSE.title: Browse
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_BROWSE.desc: Choose the folder Save Default writes to.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_UNSAVED.body: You have changed this card's art without saving. Discard those changes?
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_NO_DEFAULT.body: There was no HSV file found for this card in the designated source folder.
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_KEY.title: Key
ARTROLLER-EDITOR_KEY.desc: The file name Save and Save Default write to. A key ending in @CHARACTER is a reprint: the roll applies only while that character shows the card, and the original character keeps its own art.
